breakdown.description: The prompt uses the no-drop suddenly applied-load result P_max = 2W even though the problem includes a nonzero drop height, which changes the energy balance and the maximum force.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous shortcut P_max = 2W (the suddenly applied-load result) and instead instructs solving the full energy-conservation equation with the nonzero drop height h = 150 mm. It explicitly says to substitute δ_max into the energy equation, rearrange into a quadratic, and solve for the positive root — which is exactly the correct approach matching the ground truth prompt.
